name: Legions
overview: The term 'Legion' in Scripture highlights the reality of spiritual warfare and the authority of Christ over demonic forces, as seen when a man possessed by many demons identifies himself as 'Legion' because 'we are many' (Mark 5:9; Luke 8:30). Jesus' power surpasses these forces, demonstrated by His statement that He could call upon more than twelve legions of angels if needed (Matthew 26:53). This underscores the call to trust in Christ's authority rather than resorting to violence, as He instructs to put away the sword, warning that those who live by it will perish by it (Matthew 26:52), contrasting the old law of retaliation (Matthew 5:38).
